test_dask_dataframe_conversion: test converting a pandas DataFrame to a dask DataFrame with multiple partitions
test_dask_ufunc_computation: test applying numpy ufuncs like log on a dask Series and comparing with numpy results
test_construct_dask_float_array_int_dtyp: test constructing a pandas Series from a dask float array and verifying dtype coercion errors
test_xarray_integration: test converting a pandas DataFrame to xarray and verifying to_xarray returns a valid object
test_from_obscure_array_conversion: test converting obscure array types (dask, xarray, memoryview, array) to pandas DatetimeIndex or TimedeltaIndex
test_pyarrow_roundtrip: test roundtrip conversion between a pandas DataFrame and a pyarrow Table
test_yaml_dump_load: test dumping a pandas DataFrame to YAML and loading it back with correct equality
test_scikit_learn_fit_predict: test fitting a scikit-learn SVC classifier on numpy data and predicting on held-out samples
test_missing_dependency_error: test that pandas raises ImportError when a required dependency like numpy is missing
test_pandas_priority_dispatch: test that pandas respects __pandas_priority__ for method dispatch on custom classes
